新手教程改版：第一步用中英双语选语言，顶部可勾选下次不再打开，更新后仍记住这个选择。顶栏检测说明会跟着界面语言切换。高风险关键词检测先关闭，列表里的列还在，但不会标记或拦截。导出诊断包后可选 QQ 邮箱、Gmail、Discord（GODOG Battalion）或取消；只有选邮箱才会复制邮件。
Newcomer tutorial: bilingual language step, and a checkbox to skip it next launch (kept across updates). The top status line follows the UI language. Keyword high-risk detection is paused; the column stays but does not mark or block mods. After exporting diagnostics, choose QQ Mail, Gmail, Discord (GODOG Battalion), or Cancel. Only an email choice copies the draft.
